title: Separating the Protein of Interest from MBP after TEV Protease Cleavage
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfebjjan

steps.title: Prepare Ni Resin Column
steps.instruction: Prepare the Ni Resin column by resuspending the slurry and removing storage buffer.

substeps.instruction: Gently shake the Ni Resin bottle to completely resuspend the slurry.
Transfer the desired amount of resin to a closed column and allow it to settle.
Open the column and allow the storage buffer to flow through.

steps.title: Equilibrate Resin
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the resin using Binding buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 column volumes (CV) of Binding buffer.

steps.title: Load TEV Protease Digestion
steps.instruction: Load the TEV Protease digestion onto the column at a slow flow rate to allow binding of MBP-tag, TEV Protease, and MBP-fusion protein.

substeps.instruction: Load the digestion directly onto the equilibrated column.
Maintain a flow rate of < 1 ml/minute.

steps.title: Collect Protein of Interest
steps.instruction: Collect the flow through containing the protein of interest and maximize yield with a wash step.

substeps.instruction: Collect the initial flow through in a sterile tube.
Wash the column with 1 CV of Binding Buffer and collect the flow through.

steps.title: Process Target Protein
steps.instruction: Perform dialysis or buffer exchange on the target protein into the desired storage buffer.

steps.title: Clean Ni Resin Column
steps.instruction: Clean the column using NaOH and NaCl before final rinsing.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 Molarity (M) NaOH to the column and allow a contact time of 01:00:00 to 02:00:00.
Add 1.5 Molarity (M) NaCl to the column and allow a contact time of 00:10:00 – 00:15:00.

steps.title: Store Ni Resin
steps.instruction: Store NEBExpress Ni Resin for long-term use.
